# Decide direction

> Grills the user on a Gradatim project's open choices, from its idea and research, and records each decision. Use when the user asks for Gradatim's decide step, to settle what the research left open or be grilled on it, or to change the project's direction.

| | |
|---|---|
| Skill | `decide-direction`, [its file](../../skills/decide-direction/SKILL.md) |
| Step | 3 of 14: decide |
| Runs | After research, and whenever the direction changes |
| Next | concept on its first run; later, the step the change affects |
| Call it | `/gradatim:decide-direction` on Claude Code; [the other hosts](install.md#calling-a-skill) |

## When to use it

- The user asks for Gradatim's decide step, or to settle what the research left open, or to be grilled on it.
- The user wants to change the project's direction: who it is for, what it is, or more of the MVP's cut than a story or two. A review's pick that changes the direction comes here too.
- Not for facts: that is [`research-topics`](research-topics.md). Not for the stack or the structure: that is [`write-architecture`](write-architecture.md). Not for writing the concept, the MVP and the phases: that is [`write-concept`](write-concept.md). Not for a folder with no Gradatim project: that is [`init-project`](init-project.md).

## What it reads and writes

| Document | Path | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Agent file | `AGENTS.md` | reads |
| Concept | `docs/MAIN_CONCEPT.md` | reads |
| Research index | `docs/research/README.md` | reads |
| Research report | `docs/research/NN-<topic>.md` | reads |
| Decisions index | `docs/decisions/README.md` | reads, creates, changes |
| Decision session | `docs/decisions/NN-<topic>.md` | reads, creates, changes |
| Architecture's records | `docs/decisions/architecture.md` | reads, changes |
| Review report | `docs/artifacts/NN-review-sprint-<n>.html` | reads |

On a change, it also reads what its search for the change's reach finds. In the architecture's records it adds only a forward note. [The sync](../../skills/method/references/sync.md) changes what its own table lists. It writes nothing to git.
